## Mandatory preflight

- [ ] `pnpm validate:project-control` passed
- [ ] exactly one current item and it matches `current-work.json`
- [ ] allowed/forbidden scope reviewed
- [ ] target environment recorded
- [ ] TEST deployment authorization recorded
- [ ] Production authorization/status recorded
- [ ] conflicts and default-branch drift reported
- [ ] owner changes in all worktrees preserved

## Safety and quality

- [ ] no next Issue started automatically
- [ ] no TEST/Production deployment unless separately authorized
- [ ] no LINE OA, Cloudflare, Webhook, Rich Menu, Reward Card or secret change outside scope
- [ ] no PII, raw chat, slip, token or secret committed
- [ ] formatting, ESLint, TypeScript, tests, build and validators passed
- [ ] secret scan, dependency audit and `git diff --check` passed

- Validation summary:

- Production changed: `NO` unless separately authorized
